definition.text: Workforce planning - parameters           Version:  Budget 2026 (Reference)  [Fixed central admin settings: Entity = N01_HCM, Planning Cycle = "HR"]
Last modified Oct 19, 2026 8:53:46 by NMUNDAY

Instruction:

  1. Capture all required manual values (Parameters/Diesel&Fuel/Monetization of Mngmt benefits/Salary scales)
  2.  Execute the relevant functions to calculate the required cost elements. Below is the recommended sequence based on dependency:
    1. Monetization of management benefits:
      1. Calculate fuel rates
      2. Salary scale (NNPC and Retail)
    2. Annual Bonus (Retail/NNPC)
    3. Pension Basis

Forecast Periods:

The Salary scales should be captured/calculated in the current year. Once this is completed, the forecast periods need to be filled with the period specific values. In order to achieve this, you need to execute the 'Fill forecast Salary scale' function. This will populate all the salary scales for the forecast years. In this calculation, there will be an annual escalation applied (i.e. as captured in the parameter section)

Instruction:

  1. Capture high level % split
  2. Execute the Production/Overhead Function once these values have been captured
  3. Validate that there is a 100% allocation per cost element (i.e. There should be a split between the Production Overhead GL Accounts). If not, this implies that there is only a single GL account for the specific cost element. This can be adjusted manually.

Calculation Instructions:

Once all the salary scales have been calculated/captured (including forecast periods), you can proceed with executing the 'Cacluate Salaries' function. The current function already includes the health and pension contributions, however, you can execute these seperately if required.
